// Elastix B-spline registration --- 3D, multi-resolution
// Tuned for fly NC82 confocal -> JRC2018 NC82 template
// Use *after* affine: pass both via `elastix -p p_affine.txt -p p_bspline.txt`

(FixedInternalImagePixelType "float")
(MovingInternalImagePixelType "float")
(FixedImageDimension 3)
(MovingImageDimension 3)
(UseDirectionCosines "true")

// --- registration
(Registration "MultiResolutionRegistration")
(NumberOfResolutions 4)
(ImagePyramidSchedule 8 8 4   4 4 2   2 2 1   1 1 1)

(FixedImagePyramid "FixedSmoothingImagePyramid")
(MovingImagePyramid "MovingSmoothingImagePyramid")

(Interpolator "LinearInterpolator")
(ResampleInterpolator "FinalBSplineInterpolator")
(FinalBSplineInterpolationOrder 3)
(Resampler "DefaultResampler")

// --- metric
(Metric "AdvancedMattesMutualInformation")
(NumberOfHistogramBins 32)

// --- optimizer
(Optimizer "AdaptiveStochasticGradientDescent")
(MaximumNumberOfIterations 800 800 800 800)
(AutomaticParameterEstimation "true")

// --- sampler
(ImageSampler "RandomCoordinate")
(NumberOfSpatialSamples 8192)
(NewSamplesEveryIteration "true")

// --- transform: B-spline at decreasing grid spacing per resolution.
// Final spacing is the spacing at the last (full-resolution) step.
// 16 microns is a common fly-brain choice; FinalGridSpacingInVoxels
// scales with the FIXED image voxel spacing (0.519 um) so 32 voxels
// = 16.6 microns at the final level.
(Transform "BSplineTransform")
(GridSpacingSchedule 8 4 2 1)
(FinalGridSpacingInPhysicalUnits 16 16 16)
(BSplineTransformSplineOrder 3)

// --- output
(WriteResultImage "true")
(ResultImagePixelType "unsigned char")
(ResultImageFormat "nrrd")
(DefaultPixelValue 0)
